form.title: Tell us about your farm
form.subtitle: Enter your soil laboratory test values and local weather parameters for an instant AI recommendation.
form.nutrients_hint: Enter available macronutrients in kilograms per hectare (kg/ha) from your soil health card.
form.nitrogen_hint: Essential for vegetative leaf growth and green foliage.
form.phosphorus_hint: Crucial for early root development and flowering.
form.potassium_hint: Improves disease resistance and grain/fruit filling.
form.ph_hint: Soil pH determines the chemical availability of nutrients to crop roots.
form.weather_hint: Enter seasonal or average conditions expected during the planting cycle.
form.temperature_hint: Average ambient temperature during growing season.
form.rainfall_hint: Total seasonal rainfall or irrigation equivalent.
form.optional_hint: These parameters help organize your records and are saved in your report.

report.title: AgroVision AI — Crop Recommendation Report
report.disclaimer_text: This recommendation is generated by AgroVision AI using statistical and machine learning models trained on agricultural benchmark data. It serves as an assistive advisory tool. Farmers are advised to consult their local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) and verify physical soil lab tests before finalizing large planting or input expenditures.
